reference_quantities.note: all drag values are positive wind-axis magnitudes in newtons; CD = D/(q Sref). SU2 values use the frozen q; the RCAIDE mission uses its own atmosphere state q = 20654.014 Pa (+0.83% vs frozen). Converting between the two without stating the q used is not allowed.

rcAide_lf_component_ledger.source: evaluation/low_fidelity.py -> evaluation/mission.py -> drag_ledger.py, E2E-00 single cruise at Mach 2.02 / 18288 m

closure.why: the additive increment term is missing on this RCAIDE build, so the ledger reports PARTIAL_DATA_NOT_VALIDATED and cannot claim closure

su2_hf_wing_ledger.source: SU2 8.5.0 Euler, isolated 12D main wing, medium/fine tetrahedral meshes, Mach 2.02, AoA 2.8398 deg
su2_hf_wing_ledger.physics: inviscid pressure force only: no skin friction, no fuselage, no vertical tail, no nacelles, no interference
su2_hf_wing_ledger.note: Euler pressure drag already contains the lift-induced and wave parts of the isolated wing; it must not be added to the RCAIDE induced/compressible terms as if they were disjoint.

area_rule_ledger.source: OpenVSP 3.26.1 WaveDrag (Eminton-Lord) with an independent Python port of wavedragEL as cross-check
area_rule_ledger.CDWave_normalization: D/q in m^2 divided by OpenVSP internal reference area 100 m^2, empirically confirmed to 2e-6
area_rule_ledger.why_not_usable: Only the non-converged coarse discretization exists for a paired difference; the refined run (WAVE-05) has no paired wing-alone counterpart, and the coarse absolute level already exceeds the independently archived RCAIDE total drag (see absolute_magnitude_cross_check). The increment is therefore reported as an order-of-magnitude diagnostic only.

vspaero_lf_ledger.note: the density study (SENS-A/medium/SENS-B) showed the induced drag changing sign and growing about 65x with refinement at Mach 2.02, so the VSPAERO drag split is not usable as a drag component at all; only the CL trend is reported as a sanity check

cross_tool_comparison_not_additive.warning: the values below are different physical/model quantities measured at different CL; the table exists to expose the size of the gap, not to sum it
observations: SU2 isolated-wing Euler CD (0.0068 medium) is about half of the RCAIDE induced+compressible sum (0.0130) at a different CL (0.0928 Euler vs 0.111 isolated-wing VLM, because the mission CL includes a 1.20 fuselage lift factor).

the absolute area-rule level (wing alone CD = 0.0351 coarse, not converged) is already 5x the SU2 wing pressure drag and 2x the RCAIDE total aircraft drag, so the area-rule absolute level cannot be calibrated into the mission.

the paired wing-body area-rule increment (0.00816 CD = 59887 N) would be 48% of the RCAIDE total drag at this q; injecting it makes the cruise infeasible, which is itself a warning that the increment is not a usable correction.

deduplication_rules_proposed.rule_1: never add a coefficient from two different q/Sref systems; convert to N with the q actually used and only then partition
deduplication_rules_proposed.rule_2: RCAIDE induced (VLM Trefftz, incompressible far field) must not be added to a supersonic lift-dependent wave term without an overlap study; the archived compression of wave_lift+wave_volume into the compressible component is a build-up, not a disjoint decomposition
deduplication_rules_proposed.rule_3: Euler isolated-wing pressure drag must not be combined with the empirical RCAIDE wing drag terms; it is a replacement candidate only after a grid-converged CL-matched comparison exists
deduplication_rules_proposed.rule_4: the area-rule volume-wave increment is zero-lift only and does not include lift-dependent wave drag, fuselage friction or all wing-body interference
deduplication_rules_proposed.rule_5: the increment additive slot in the RCAIDE ledger must stay null until an independently calibrated correction exists

missing_terms: calibrated wing-body interference / body correction (BODY-CORR BLOCKED)
fuselage and vertical-tail pressure drag at supersonic speed (not measured)
viscous drag at Reynolds number 8.94e7 (no RANS, Euler is inviscid)
validated lift-dependent wave drag (RCAIDE empirical JAXA correlation unvalidated)
trim drag in a trimmed mission (the cruise segment uses a fixed alpha control)
decomposed parasite drag per component (the RCAIDE ledger reports only the aggregate)
CL-matched comparison between LF and HF (the two chains ran at different CL)

verdict.why: no measured quantity in this run can be promoted to a validated aircraft drag correction: LF VSPAERO drag is non-physical, HF Euler covers only the isolated wing and is not grid-converged, and the area-rule increment is non-converged and contradicts the independent RCAIDE drag level. All values are reported as diagnostics with their uncertainties.
